items.text: Final report: Cleveland ruled out G Teven Jenkins (back), DTs Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) and Kalia Davis (quad) and backup QB Dillon Gabriel (back); CB Denzel Ward (hand), S Grant Delpit (concussion/shoulder), LB Quincy Williams and RB Dylan Sampson are questionable. Deshaun Watson starts.
Final report: Tennessee has no one ruled out; WR Calvin Ridley (hip), RB Tyjae Spears, LB Dorian Mausi and S Tony Adams and Kevin Winston Jr. are questionable. Cam Ward starts.
